name: kaal-engineering
description: Engineering repository for KAAL. The distributable packages are under packages/.

scripts.test:hosting:evidence: npm run build -w @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting && node engineering/lanes/hosting.mjs --evidence engineering/out/evidence
scripts.test:kaal: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.test:workspaces:evidence: npm run build -w @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting && node engineering/lanes/workspaces.mjs --evidence engineering/out/evidence
scripts.test:engineering: npm run build -w @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting && node --test engineering/github/lineage.test.ts engineering/change-isolation/check.test.mjs engineering/boundary.test.mjs engineering/delivery/pack.test.mjs engineering/report/captures.test.mjs engineering/lanes/evidence.test.mjs engineering/lanes/lanes.test.mjs engineering/contracts/measure.test.mjs engineering/guard/external/deliver.test.mjs engineering/guard/consumer/harness.test.mjs engineering/guard/acceptance/authority.test.mjs engineering/release/release.test.mjs
scripts.attribution: npm run build -w @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting -w kaal-core && node engineering/inventory/attribute.mjs
scripts.report: npm run build -w @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting -w kaal-core && node engineering/report/measure.mjs
